description: This file defines a React component named NoteItem that displays a single note with the ability to edit and delete it. It includes state management for editing mode, draft fields, pending actions, and error handling.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the edited note by calling the onUpdate callback; handles pending state and errors.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Cancels editing mode, restoring draft fields to the note's current values.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the note by calling the onDelete callback after user confirmation.
